title: DOH monitors monkey‑linked malaria cases in Northern Palawan

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Health in Mimaropa is monitoring cases of malaria caused by a monkey‑borne parasite in northern Palawan, particularly in the municipalities of Roxas and San Vicente. Malaria attributed to the parasite Plasmodium knowlesi has been confirmed after an assessment conducted together with experts from the World Health Organization and the Pilipinas Shell Foundation Inc., according to Oscar Macam Jr., DOH vector‑borne disease coordinator in Mimaropa. Plasmodium knowlesi originates in monkeys and is transmitted to humans through the bite of infected Anopheles mosquitoes.
